en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_town_ongoing: $names$ follows the tour group into the nightclub as their "Tokyo girlfriend".
en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_town_result: In the club's booth, $names$ is wedged into the middle of the sofa.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_01:
The booth was chosen with care: the lighting is exactly dark enough for "can't quite see, but everyone knows".
The drinks come round after round. Wedged between the lead rapper and the manager, she has hands sliding up from under her hem, in full view of the booth.
The shutters from the daytime streets are still ringing in her ears - the streetwear storefronts, the gacha machines, the poses she was told to strike, the strangers' phones. She has no idea where those clips end up.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_02:
"Showtime."
She is ordered up onto the coffee table to dance. Nothing under the hem; when the sweep of the light passes over her, the whole floor's eyes come down at once.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_03:
Kneeling in front of the sofa, she alternates between the lead and two of the entourage. The rest watch over their drinks, whistle, and film with their phones.
Wherever the spotlight sweeps, the shutters follow.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_04:
In the small hours, the second-floor lounge is bought out. She is pressed into the corner of the sofa, skirt rolled to her waist, taken from the front by the lead.
The crowd around them doesn't disperse - some lean in to watch, some reach out to grope her, some hold their phones as close as they can.
Her hair is pulled, tilting her face up: "Face. --Smile. Smile for camera."
en-us.event_erav_celeb_town_05:
At closing, the manager smooths her skirt back down for her, the way one puts away a prop.
"Tokyo girls, so open! --Tomorrow, same schedule."
